scope: File-level inspection of the public Ramea hydrogen-station capacity repository

source.description: Hydrogen Refueling Station Capacity Dataset for California
source.author: Kalai Ramea / Palo Alto Research Center

observed_archive.nominal_sampling: approximately 30-minute intervals (README); repository description says hourly
observed_archive.observed_signal: remaining/available station capacity percentage or capacity indicator; no direct mass-flow channel

rights.decision: Do not redistribute the CSV archive inside this project; cite/link the public repository and request written reuse terms before derived-publication redistribution.

eligibility_decision.reason: The archive has no common station-to-vehicle event time base, vehicle/receptacle pressure, vehicle/tank temperature or mass-flow/transferred-mass trace, protocol metadata or explicit repository reuse license.
valid_uses: aggregate demand and availability face-validity context
data-request lead to the original custodian
excluded_uses: calibration or tuning of the production fueling model

claim_boundary: This is a real-station aggregate capacity resource and improves operating-context evidence, but it does not close the independent full-loop validation gate or support an IJHE-level validation claim by itself.
next_action: Retain the source link and citation, ask the custodian for the data dictionary, exact capacity semantics, station metadata and reuse terms, and keep the frozen full-loop holdout protocol unchanged.
